Evan Brooks: Hi team — Evan here, starting as a Site Reliability Engineer on Eng SRE. First day vibes! :wave: A few quick setup questions and one fun fact: I brew espresso and have a terrible plant collection.

devex: Welcome Evan!! :tada: Quick items: join #eng-sre, #oncall, #incidents; file a hardware request if you need a dock. Need a 1:1 walkthrough? I can set one up today.

Jules Ramirez: Welcome! For pager access, you need to be in the `pagerduty-sre` group and complete the on-call training. Ping me when you're ready and I'll add you to the cohort.

Evan Brooks: Thanks! I tried to sign into PagerDuty but it timed out. Is there a separate invite?

hr-bot: Evan Brooks  HR note: please accept the PagerDuty invite sent to your work email. If you didn't get it, reply here and we'll resend.

Ian Cole: Hey Evan — ping me your work email and I'll trigger a resend. Also FYI we use 2FA with a YubiKey or Authenticator app.

Evan Brooks: Sent email via DM (evan.brooks@redwood.com). Also Q about dev laptop: I selected the Linux ThinkPad option; will that ship today?

devex: Laptop orders usually ship within 2 business days. If you need a temporary loaner, reply to the hardware ticket and tag @devex.

Jules Ramirez: If you want early access to our chaos testbed, let me know — I can add you after you finish the safety checklist.

Evan Brooks: Fun fact time: I once rode my bike 200 miles in one weekend, and my plant that survived is a cactus named Spike.

Lina Gomez: Welcome!! We have a SRE lunch at 12:30 today — bring your plant stories. Also, swipe for sticker packs in the kitchen.

Evan Brooks: I'll be there — thanks everyone.

sre-bot: Automated: Evan Brooks added to #eng-sre at 2269998888. Reminder: complete incident response training within 5 days.

Ian Cole: All set on the PagerDuty invite, Evan — you should have access now. If anything else blocks you DM me.

Evan Brooks: Confirmed I can sign in. Appreciate the warm welcome :smile:
